UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents a Class 10 student profile, including user metadata, preferences, search history, and saved notes.

uid.description: The unique Firebase Auth User ID

ChatQueries.title: ChatQueries
ChatQueries.description: Represents study questions asked to Gemini AI by students for review on their dashboard.

queryId.description: Unique identifier for the study query

userId.description: The ID of the student asking the question

answer.description: The simple explanation generated by Gemini AI

language.description: The language of the conversation (en or hi)

Donations.title: Donations
Donations.description: Represents student contributions/donations to support LIRAVEN creators.

userId.description: Firebase Auth ID of the donor, if logged in

donorName.description: The name of the donor or anonymous

/users/{userId}.description: Firestore path for custom student profiles, secure to the authenticated owner.

/queries/{queryId}.description: Firestore path for tutoring queries to show student studies history on dashboard.

/donations/{donationId}.description: Firestore path for public/private donation histories.
